notes: This lock is the programmable-tested baseline set, byte for byte, plus one entry: the solmate revision that Uniswap v4 Core's own ProtocolFees imports transitively. Every other pin is identical to the platform definition. The baseline is recorded as model-specific-pinned only because the platform set is frozen and cannot carry that transitive entry, not because this project selected a different dependency graph.

Choosing model-specific-pinned adds the model-specific-dependency-review and model-specific-architecture-review candidate gates. Both are recorded in gate-status.json as maintainer-owned and not started.

Uniswap Liquidity Launcher, Uniswap UERC20 Factory and Permit2 are part of the baseline definition but are not imported by any contract under src/; they are listed for baseline identity, not because this project builds against them.

solmate is reached only through Uniswap v4 Core's own vendored checkout at lib/v4-core/lib/solmate, because v4 Core's ProtocolFees imports Owned and the suite deploys a real PoolManager. No contract under src/ imports solmate. Its checkout is clean at the revision and tree recorded above.
The compiler source revision identifies the source, not the executable. The resolved solc binary and its full standard-JSON input and output are recorded separately in evidence/build-info.json.

evidence/build-info.json was produced by the official solc 0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a binary run over the exact standard-JSON input Foundry emitted, because Foundry 1.7.1 records the release as `0.8.26` with no commit suffix of its own.

The same official compiler binary, run over the pinned lib/v4-core checkout under Uniswap's own build settings, reproduces the deployed mainnet PoolManager runtime exactly; see evidence/deployment-v4-poolmanager-ethereum.json.
